name: Security
description:
Threat intelligence and anonymization signals for the IP. Only returned when
`include=security` or `include=*` is used. Costs 2 additional credits.

threat_score.description:
Overall threat score from 0 (clean) to 100 (high risk). Aggregated from
all the individual signals below.

is_tor.description: Whether the IP is a known Tor exit node.

is_proxy.description: Whether the IP belongs to a known proxy service.

proxy_provider_names.description: Names of proxy providers associated with this IP, if any.

proxy_confidence_score.description:
Confidence that this IP is a proxy, from 0 to 100. Only meaningful when
`is_proxy` is `true`.

proxy_last_seen.description:
Date when this IP was last observed acting as a proxy, in `YYYY-MM-DD`
format. Empty string if never seen.

is_residential_proxy.description: Whether the IP is a known residential proxy.

is_vpn.description: Whether the IP belongs to a known VPN provider.

vpn_provider_names.description: Names of VPN providers associated with this IP, if any.

vpn_confidence_score.description:
Confidence that this IP is a VPN endpoint, from 0 to 100. Only meaningful
when `is_vpn` is `true`.

vpn_last_seen.description:
Date when this IP was last observed as a VPN endpoint, in `YYYY-MM-DD`
format. Empty string if never seen.

is_relay.description: Whether the IP is part of a known relay network (e.g. iCloud Private Relay).

relay_provider_name.description: Name of the relay provider, if any. Empty string if not a relay.

is_anonymous.description:
Whether the IP is associated with any anonymization method (VPN, proxy,
Tor, or relay).

is_known_attacker.description: Whether the IP has been flagged in known attacker or threat feeds.

is_bot.description: Whether the IP is associated with known bot activity.

is_spam.description: Whether the IP is listed in spam databases.

is_cloud_provider.description: Whether the IP belongs to a cloud hosting or data center provider.

cloud_provider_name.description: Name of the cloud provider, if applicable. Empty string otherwise.
